$comment: Release-order declarations, read by rediacc_ci.release.order.account_refusal before an account Worker deploy.

An entry is active once its `since` commit is an ancestor of the account pointer being deployed; an active entry admits the deploy only when the channel's published CLI (the R2 cli/<channel>/manifest.json version V, sealed by cli/v<V>/.released and tagged v<V>) contains every `cli_commits` sha.

entries.why: private/account/src/routes/configs.ts refuses a config pull that sends no usable x-config-envelope header against a v3 store (426), so a CLI that predates the header, rdc config pull and the serve executor's pull alike, stops reading its configs once this account code is live.
